thesis: Closure is not the universe itself; it is the generator/operator that takes relations (topoi, paths, verifications) and produces further structure until evaluation/halting/fixed-point identification becomes possible. IVI is the ladder of how verification becomes closable; NRR is the multi-directional admissible bundle above single collapses.

primitive.name: 0 ↔ ∞ duality (Pure Place)
primitive.rule: Pre-phenomenal substrate: only dual limits, no orientation, no algebra, no collapse. Past-like 0 and future-like ∞ interact potentially into higher complexity without a midpoint object.

ladder.name: IVI-2 Orientation
rules: Still no forced closure / no collapse

ladder.name: IVI-3 Triality / Collapse level
rules: Resuperposition: paths recombine with order sensitivity
Non-invertible closure: some recombinations cannot be undone locally
Holonomy algebra minimally Q₈ when closure is demanded

ladder.name: IVI-4+ projections
rules: Further effective theories as constrained projections of closure

core_structures.name: Closure as generator/operator
core_structures.rule: Closure takes an arbitrary topos/relation and constructs further layers until Turing-encoding and halting-evaluation become possible; fixed eval appears unitary; layers/inversions that match relational and encoding topoi are closure.

core_structures.name: Collapse (diagonal connection)
core_structures.rule: Collapse = diagonal connection 0→0 or ∞→∞; violates von Neumann adjacency; resolves −1 holonomy; rotates by ½i locally; topological not probabilistic; costs verification energy K; forced when local refinement fails.

core_structures.name: NRR resuperposition / closure bundle
core_structures.rule: Higher object that does not keep old collapse as fixed state; absorbs the set of admissible diagonals/potentials collapse could have selected; re-expresses them as new closure with global energy i e^K and local complexity-length ω_K.
core_structures.relation_to_collapse: collapse = one directional realization; NRR = multi-directional admissible potential bundle

core_structures.name: 0↔∞ predual diagonal
core_structures.rule: i = rotation (Kakeya); r = extension (Chaitin). Predual Fourier reverses end, direction, scaling, order; Möbius ±1/0 as path-end/collapse of closure.

core_structures.name: Resonance community (axiom II)
core_structures.rule: For each context c, closed convex C_c ⊆ H; evolution projects toward resonance (axiom III / continuous projection–drift).
core_structures.role: dynamics layer sitting on color/Hilbert substrate

core_structures.name: Identifiability / retained state
core_structures.rule: What survives across collapse–resuperposition cycles as witnessable structure (ledger/memory of admissible relations), distinguishing formal IVI objects from contingent instantiations.

bridge_rules.rule: Gravity = global well-foundedness of verification (no infinite descending contradiction); GR effective description of IVI-3+ consistency; time = refinement order not dimension
Quantum = local non-invertibility + resuperposition + partial verification; qubits on relations not points; measurement = finite Euclidean closure
Observed Möbius/Mertens imbalance is square-root shadow of deeper NRR mass: collapse residue ≲ √(active NRR energy)
light/token operator → communities (closure-derived equal relations) → η/meta-vectors → tip-to-tail lattice → fractal mutual containment → 0↔∞ predual diagonal
